title: Topic 11
japanese_text: ［バスケットボール］高校の全国大会で、主人公のチームは優勝候補を破る大<u>金星</u>をあげた。だが、その試合で<u>完全燃焼</u>してしまったため、次の3回戦では<u>無名</u>の高校にやすやすと <u>敗北</u>した。
english_translation: [Basketball] The main character's team won a glorious victory at a national high school tournament, defeating the championship contenders. However, because they gave their all in that game, they were easily beaten by a no-name high school in the following third round.

annotated_words.meaning_en: glorious victory, defeat of a stronger opponent
